author: Josh Ayen
title: Power play propels Komets to overtime win against Fuel - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen ,
1 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – The Komets’ magic number to clinch the ECHL’s Central Division title is down to one point. That margin shrunk after Fort Wayne rallied past the Indy Fuel in a 4-3 overtime win on Wednesday.
William Dufour continued his scorching play for the Komets. The reigning ECHL Player of the Week netted two power play goals, including the game-winner in overtime. Dufour has scored eight goals in the past four games, including 11 points in that span.
The Komets wasted little time taking an early lead on Wednesday. Austin Magera scored his 30th goal of the season at 2:26 of the first period on a power play off a rebound from Dufour. However, the Fuel tied the game at 7:25 to make it a 1-1 contest at the first intermission.
Fort Wayne was much more solid in the second period. Dufour struck his first goal of the night on a power play at 13:32 to give the Komets a 2-1 lead heading into the final period.
Indy rallied with back-to-back goals over the first nine minutes of the third period. Tyler Paquette put the Fuel in front at 8:41 to make it a 3-2 game. The Komets answered with a game-tying goal from Kirill Tyutyayev. Fort Wayne’s points leader finished his night with a goal and two assists.
With the game tied at 3-3 at the end of regulation, the Komets and Fuel settled their final regular season meeting in overtime. The Komets earned a power play after a hooking call on Indy’s Jadon Joseph at 2:23. Dufour took full advantage by scoring the game winner at 3:05 of the extra period.
The Komets only need one point over their final two games to lock up a division title. Fort Wayne can clinch the Central Divsion with a win or an overtime loss to the Toledo Walleye on Thursday. The first puck drop for that game is scheduled for 7:35 p.m. at Memorial Coliseum.
